Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal inspectors general offices, CIGIE employees, and agencies involved in government oversight and training.
dimensions.evidence: The Council of the Inspectors General on Integrity and Efficiency, as established by section 424 of title 5, United States Code, is abolished

dimensions.assessment: Dissolves an independent council governing federal inspector general coordination, separating its personnel and reallocating responsibilities.
dimensions.evidence: effective on the abolishment date... any individual who is an officer or employee of the Council of the Inspectors General on Integrity and Efficiency shall be separated from the civil service.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers revolving funds, appropriations, and assets to the Federal Law Enforcement Training Centers and OMB without detailing net savings or costs.
dimensions.evidence: Any amounts that are available in the Inspectors General Council Fund... are hereby transferred to the Director of the Federal Law Enforcement Training Centers.

dimensions.assessment: Makes extensive statutory and conforming amendments across multiple titles of the U.S. Code to dismantle CIGIE and reassign oversight, training, and dispute resolution duties.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 5, United States Code, to abolish the Council of the Inspectors General on Integrity and Efficiency, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent structural reorganization of federal inspector general oversight and coordination functions taking effect one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The abolishment date specified in this paragraph is the date that is 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific fiscal estimates of cost savings or transition expenditures resulting from the council's abolishment.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill abolishes the Council of the Inspectors General on Integrity and Efficiency (CIGIE) one year after enactment, transferring and reassigning its functions to OMB, the Comptroller General, and other entities.
